summary: The small-L argument is valid and avoids unjustified quadratic monotonicity. Snapshot and manuscript digests match. No revision is needed for this step.

checks.scope: Small-L branches for three and six codegrees
checks.method: Enumerated codegree tuples in {0,...,6} cubed and to the sixth power, testing every 0 <= L <= min(sum,k-1); also inspected manifest-verified MomentArithmetic.lean and checked the symbolic factorization.
checks.observation: All 1,024 three-codegree and 705,564 six-codegree tests passed. For 0 <= L <= k, L(L-k) <= 0 while 2k times the binomial sum is nonnegative. For S >= L >= k, the difference (S squared-kS)-(L squared-kL)=(S-L)(S+L-k) is nonnegative. Thus the symbolic argument covers unbounded nonnegative integer codegrees; enumeration is only diagnostic corroboration. The Lean helper uses precisely this case split, including the endpoint L=k.
